DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交通教室の資料について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the traffic safety class materials?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。交差点で警察の方が笛を吹いていました。この資料には手の動きがありますが、音の意味も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 教室資料を示し交差点で聞いた笛の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A police officer was blowing a whistle at an intersection. These materials show hand movements, but I would also like to know what the sounds mean.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the class materials and ask what the whistle you heard at the intersection meant. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 笛の音で周囲に注意を向けてもらい、手の合図などを見てもらうことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sometimes the whistle is used to draw people's attention so they will look at the hand signals and other instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 音を聞いたら、警察の方がどちらに向けて何を示しているか見るのですね。長い音だけ覚えればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 音だけでなく警察の示す方向と合図を見ると理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So when I hear it, I should look at which direction the officer is facing and what they are indicating. I thought I only needed to remember the long whistle sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you understand you should look at the direction and signals the officer indicates, as well as listen to the sound. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の場面では、音だけからご自分で進む方向を決めず、出されている合図を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: In an actual situation, please check the signals being given rather than deciding which way to go based only on the sound.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。私は歩いていて、車への合図を自分への合図かと迷いました。教室で歩行者の場合も聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩行中に車向け合図で迷い歩行者向け説明も聞きたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I was walking and wasn't sure whether a signal for cars was meant for me. Can I also ask about pedestrians in the class?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that a signal for cars confused you while you were walking and that you would also like an explanation for pedestrians. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この教室では歩行者の参加も受け付けています。質問したい所を資料に印を付けてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Pedestrians are welcome to attend this class too. Please mark the points you want to ask about in the materials and bring them along.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここに印を付けます。聞いた音を書いたメモもあるので、音だけでは判断できなかったと説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 質問箇所に印を付け聞いた音メモも教室へ持参すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll mark this part. I also have a note describing the sound I heard, so I want to explain that I couldn't work it out from the sound alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will mark the points you want to ask about and bring your note about the sound to the class too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 教室の案内は、こちらにあります。開催日時をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the information about the class. Please check the date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 土曜の午前ですね。参加できるか予定を見て、申込先へ問い合わせます。今日は資料と案内を持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 土曜予定を確認して申込先へ問合せ資料を持帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Saturday morning, then. I'll check my schedule to see whether I can attend and contact the registration office. I'll take the materials and information home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check your Saturday schedule, contact the registration office, and take the materials home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、教室でもご質問ください。お帰りの道もお気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please ask your questions at the class too. Take care on your way home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛名のラベルをお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an address label with you, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。印刷が大きすぎて、封筒に貼ると端からはみ出します。小さく切ってもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きすぎる宛名ラベルの切り方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The print is too large, and the label sticks out over the edge when I put it on the envelope. May I trim it smaller?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to trim an address label that is too large. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所や名前を切らず、周りの余白を整えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please trim the blank space around it without cutting off the address or name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 文字のない所だけ切ります。住所の一番下の部屋番号も、全部残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 余白だけ切り住所部屋番号を残すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll cut only the parts with no text. I want to keep the entire room number at the very bottom of the address too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will trim only the blank space and keep the address and room number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封筒に乗せて、収まるか見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's place it on the envelope and see whether it fits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これなら収まります。ラベルの角が切手の場所に重なっているので、少し下へずらします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 収まりを確認し切手と重ならない位置へ動かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It fits like this. The corner of the label overlaps the space for the stamp, so I'll move it down a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check that it fits and move it to a position where it does not overlap the stamp. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その位置なら、切手を貼る部分も空きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That position leaves room for the stamp too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この位置で貼ります。住所と名前は全部読めて、上には切手を貼る空きもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛名の可読性と切手用の空きを確認してラベルを貼ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll stick it here. The whole address and name are readable, and there is space above for the stamp.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will attach the label after checking that the address is readable and there is room for the stamp. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 貼り付けた後も、端が浮いていないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After attaching it, please also check that the edges are not lifting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部貼れました。住所と名前が読めて、部屋番号もあります。この封筒を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 貼付後宛名番号を確認して差し出すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's fully attached. The address and name are readable, and the room number is there too. I'll mail this envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked the address and number after attaching the label and will hand in the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お預かりします。ラベルのご準備ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take it, then. Thank you for preparing the label. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ＡＴＭの操作について、お手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like help using the ATM?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 操作は終わったと思いますが、まだ自分の名前が画面に出ています。離れてよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自名が残るＡＴＭ画面で退出してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think I've finished, but my name is still displayed on the screen. I don't know whether I can leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may leave the ATM while your name is still on the screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示に「終了」のボタンはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there a Finish button on the display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。控えを取って、そこを押すのを忘れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 終了ボタンの押し忘れに気づいたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I took the receipt and forgot to press it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have realized you forgot to press the Finish button. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身で終了を押してください。初めの画面へ戻るか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please press Finish yourself. We'll check whether it returns to the initial screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 押しました。最初の案内に戻りました。カードも財布にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 終了後初期画面と自己カード所持を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've pressed it. It has returned to the opening instructions. My card is in my wallet too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the initial screen after finishing and confirm that you have your own card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えの紙も、お取りになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you also taken the paper receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。隣に置いた封筒へ入れたので、紙を機械に残してはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えを手元封筒へ入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have it. I put it in the envelope I had beside me, so I haven't left any paper in the machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you put the receipt in the envelope you have with you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お金や、ほかのお荷物もそろっているかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check that you have your money and all your other belongings too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部あります。画面が戻ったのを見たので、場所を空けます。最後まで教えていただいて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金と荷物と画面を確認して場所を空けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have everything. I've seen that the screen has returned, so I'll move away now. Your help right through to the end was very useful.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked your money, belongings, and the screen, and will move away. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're welcome. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品が読み取れませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you unable to scan this item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この袋だけ音が鳴りません。お菓子ですが、まだ画面の一覧に出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 菓子一袋だけ読み取り音と画面登録がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Only this bag doesn't beep. It's sweets, but it hasn't appeared in the list on the screen yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that one bag of sweets has neither produced a scanning sound nor appeared on the screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: バーコードの所を見せてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここです。袋の折れ目に半分隠れているので、うまく当てられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 折れ目に半分隠れたバーコードを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. Half of it is hidden in a fold in the bag, so I can't position it properly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the barcode that is half hidden in a fold. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋を開けずに、この部分を平らに持ちましょう。私が読み取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's hold this part flat without opening the bag. I'll scan it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。中身を出す必要があるかと思いましたが、袋は閉じたまま持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封の袋を保持して店員読取りを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I thought I might need to take out the contents, but I'll hold the bag closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold the unopened bag and ask the staff member to scan it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読み取れました。画面に商品名と一個の表示が出ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It scanned successfully. The product name and a quantity of one have appeared on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出ましたね。同じ物がもう一袋あるので、そちらも読ませます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一袋目登録を確認し同商品二袋目も読ませると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There it is. I have another bag of the same thing, so I'll scan that one too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the first bag is registered and say that you will scan a second bag of the same item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二袋目も入りました。合計二個でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The second bag is registered too. Is a total of two correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、二個です。ほかの商品はもう一覧にあります。全部入ったことを見てから支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二袋と他商品の一覧を確認後に払うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, two. The other items are already in the list. I'll pay after checking that everything is registered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay after checking the two bags and the other items in the list. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お支払いへお進みください。ご利用ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed to payment. Thank you for shopping with us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩場所について、何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can I help you with somewhere to take a break?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもとボール遊びをして、得点を書いています。紙が曲がるので、平らな所で書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遊び得点を記入できる平らな所を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm playing ball with my child and writing down our scores. The paper bends, so I'd like a flat place to write.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are looking for a flat place to write down the scores from your game. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 休憩用のテーブルをお使いいただけます。あちらの端が空いていますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You may use a table in the rest area. The end over there is free.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。荷物を全部広げず、この一枚だけ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短時間で紙一枚だけテーブルへ置くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I'll put down just this one sheet without spreading out all our things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the table briefly and put down only one sheet of paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 何人分の得点でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: How many people's scores are you recording?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私と子どもの二人分です。途中で数字がにじんだので、見える所を新しい紙へ写します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人分のにじんだ記録を新紙へ写したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two, mine and my child's. Some of the numbers became smudged partway through, so I'll copy the parts I can read onto new paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to copy the smudged records for two people onto new paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お子さんと確認しながら書けそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you think you can write them down while checking with your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。子どもは三点と言っています。私は二点しか覚えていないので、今の紙を二人で見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子供三点と自己記憶二点を元紙で確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My child says three points. I only remember two, so we'll look at the current sheet together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the original sheet to check your child's claim of three points against your memory of two. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 机を使い終えたら、紙や筆記具をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you finish using the table, please take your paper and writing materials with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。勝った人を今決めるより、記録を確認します。書けたら机を空けて、また遊ぶか子どもに聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後に机を空け子供と次の遊びを相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I'll check the record rather than deciding the winner now. Once I've written it down, I'll clear the table and ask my child whether they want to play again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after checking, you will clear the table and discuss what to play next with your child. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、親子で楽しくお過ごしください。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your time together. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車分の領収書についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a receipt for your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会社へ提出したいです。購入したときの控えを持ってきたので、こちらで相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社提出用の乗車領収書について購入控えで相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to submit it to my company. I brought the purchase slip; can I discuss it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a receipt for your journey to submit to your company, using the purchase slip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えを拝見します。宛名は会社名をご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me look at the slip. You would like it made out to your company, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「山川企画」でお願いします。山と川、そのあと企画です。小さい紙にも書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 架空会社名山川企画の表記を紙で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please make it out to Yamakawa Kikaku. The characters mean mountain, river, and then planning. I've written it on this small piece of paper too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the written form of the fictional company name Yamakawa Kikaku on paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その表記で確認します。対象の乗車分は、この一件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check that spelling. Is this single journey the one the receipt should cover?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、この一件です。別の日の私用の分も財布にありますが、そちらは今回は出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象一件と私用乗車分を別にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, just this one. I also have a slip for a personal journey on another day in my wallet, but I won't submit that one this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the one relevant journey separate from your personal journey. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前の表記も、こちらの紙で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the spelling of the name on this paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社名は合っています。受け取ったら、控えと領収書を同じ封筒へ入れて持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛名一致と控え同封保管の希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The company name is correct. Once I receive it, I'd like to put the purchase slip and receipt in the same envelope and take them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the name matches and that you would like to keep the purchase slip enclosed with the receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの領収書をお渡しします。記載内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is your receipt. Please check the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛名と対象の乗車分を確認できました。今日はこの一枚を受け取り、会社へ提出する書類と一緒に保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受領した宛名対象を確認し会社資料と保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the name and the journey it covers. I'll receive this one receipt today and keep it with the documents I will submit to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the name and journey covered by the receipt you received, and say that you will keep it with the company documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、控えもお返しします。お忘れ物のないようにお持ちください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll return your purchase slip too. Please take everything with you. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 来訪されるご家族への案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this information for family members who will be visiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族はまだ海外にいます。英語の地域案内を、来る前に携帯で読める形で送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外滞在中の家族へ英語案内を携帯形式で送りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My family is still overseas. I want to send them an English guide to the area in a form they can read on their phones before they arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to send an English guide in a phone-readable form to your family overseas. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙の冊子は日本語ですが、英語の案内ページをご覧いただけます。こちらのコードで開けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The printed booklet is in Japanese, but you can view a guide page in English. You can open it with this code.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯で開きたいです。このコードを読み取れば、案内のページへ行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: コードから案内ページへ行けるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to open it on my phone. Will scanning this code take me to the guide page?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the code leads to the guide page. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。このページで英語を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please select English on this page.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 英語の見出しが出ました。家族へページのリンクを送るので、紙の冊子は今回はいただかなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 英語表示を確認しリンク送付紙冊子不要を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The English heading has appeared. I'll send my family the page link, so I don't need the printed booklet this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the English display and explain that you will send the link and do not need the printed booklet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見ていただきたい項目は、お決まりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided which section you would like them to look at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 街歩きの地図です。家族が来る前に、行ってみたい場所を三つ選んでもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 街歩き地図で家族に三希望地を選んでもらうと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The map for walking around town. Before they arrive, I'll ask my family to choose three places they'd like to visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your family to choose three desired destinations using the town walking map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 地図の項目は、こちらから開けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can open the map section here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 開けました。ページを家族へ送り、読めたら希望の場所を返信してもらいます。来訪の日まで一緒に予定を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地図リンクを送り読了と希望返信で予定作成すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've opened it. I'll send the page to my family and ask them to reply with the places they'd like to visit once they've read it. We'll plan together until the day they arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will send the map link and make plans after they read it and reply with their preferred places. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、その案内をお役立てください。ご家族を迎えるご準備が進みますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make use of the guide. I hope your preparations for welcoming your family go well. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お付き添いの方ですね。何か必要な物はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're accompanying someone, correct? Is there anything you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 妻の診察を待っています。赤ちゃんのおむつを替えたいので、使える場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 妻診察待ちの付き添いとしておむつ替え場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm waiting for my wife's consultation. I'd like to change the baby's diaper; please tell me where I can do that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: As someone accompanying your wife while waiting for her consultation, ask where to change a diaper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この通路の奥に、おむつ替えの部屋をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can direct you to a diaper-changing room at the end of this corridor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。妻はこの席で待っています。私が赤ちゃんと移動すると、先に妻へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 妻へ赤ちゃんとの移動を先に知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. My wife is waiting in this seat. I'll tell her first that I'm taking the baby there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tell your wife in advance that you will be moving with the baby. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物は、ご一緒にお持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Will you take your belongings with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: おむつの袋は私が持ちます。妻の鞄は本人の手元に残し、赤ちゃん用の物だけ持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 赤ちゃん用品を持ち妻鞄は本人へ残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll carry the diaper bag. I'll leave my wife's bag with her and take only the things for the baby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the baby's supplies and leave your wife's bag with her. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お戻りになる席は、お分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know which seat to return to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口から二列目の窓側です。戻るときは同じ席へ行き、妻が呼ばれていたら受付へ尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 戻る席位置と妻呼出済時の確認先を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's by the window in the second row from the entrance. I'll return to the same seat, and if my wife has been called, I'll ask at reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the location of the seat you will return to and say where you will ask if your wife has already been called. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 部屋の表示はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the sign for the room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「おむつ替え室」ですね。表示を見て奥へ進みます。終わったら赤ちゃんと一緒に席へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: おむつ替え室表示を確認し奥へ行き終後戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: It says Diaper-changing Room. I'll follow the sign to the end of the corridor. When we're done, I'll return to the seat with the baby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the diaper-changing room sign, go to the end of the corridor, and say that you will return afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの通路へどうぞ。ご不明なことがあればお声がけください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use this corridor, then. Let us know if you have any questions. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 学校の課題についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a school assignment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語教室で地域の仕事を紹介します。交番の仕事について、十分ほどお話を聞く時間を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日本語教室の課題で交番仕事の十分取材を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm introducing local jobs in my Japanese class. I'd like to discuss arranging about ten minutes to hear about the work of a police box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a ten-minute interview on police box work for a Japanese class assignment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 教室の名前と、課題の案内を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the name of your class and the assignment instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「みどり日本語教室」です。この紙が課題の案内です。私一人が来て、聞いたことをクラスで紹介します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 架空教室名課題案内と本人一人での発表目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's Midori Japanese Class. This paper explains the assignment. I'll come alone and present what I've learned to my class.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the fictional class name, the assignment instructions, and that you alone will visit to prepare a class presentation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どのようなことを質問されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: What would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 道を尋ねた人への案内と、落とし物を受け付ける仕事についてです。質問を二つ紙に書いてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道案内と落とし物受付の二質問を用意したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Giving directions to people who ask and accepting lost property. I've written two questions on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have prepared two questions about giving directions and accepting lost property. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へその紙をお渡しします。記録の方法も、ご希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll give that paper to the person in charge. Do you have a preferred way to record the conversation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 録画はせず、ノートへ書きます。聞き取れなかった所はその場で聞き直したいです。日時は担当の方と合わせられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 録画せず筆記し聞直しと日程調整を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't make a video; I'll write in my notebook. I'd like to ask again on the spot if I don't catch something. I can arrange the date and time to suit the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will take notes without video recording, want to ask again when needed, and can coordinate the schedule. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から候補の日時をご連絡します。連絡先をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will contact you with possible dates and times. Please give me your contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この携帯番号です。提出する質問紙の写しは自分にもあります。連絡をいただいたら、候補の日時を教室の予定と照らして返事します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人番号質問控えを示し候補日時を確認返信すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is my mobile number. I also have a copy of the question sheet I'm submitting. When you contact me, I'll compare the proposed dates and times with my class schedule and reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your own phone number and question copy, and say that you will check and reply about the proposed dates and times. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご依頼を担当へお伝えします。それでは、ご連絡をお待ちください。お越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass your request to the person in charge. Please wait to hear from them. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切手を貼るところで、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble attaching a stamp?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このシール式の切手を買いましたが、裏の紙がうまくはがれません。角を出す方法を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入済シール切手の裏紙はがしを見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought this self-adhesive stamp, but I can't peel the backing paper off properly. Could you show me how to lift a corner?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to be shown how to peel the backing off a self-adhesive stamp you have already bought. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの角を少し浮かせます。そこから裏紙をゆっくり引いてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll lift this corner slightly. Try slowly pulling the backing paper from there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持てる角ができました。切手を折らず、この裏紙の方を引きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 浮いた角から裏紙を引くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Now there's a corner I can hold. I'll pull this backing paper without bending the stamp.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will pull the backing paper from the lifted corner. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 裏紙が外れましたね。貼る封筒は、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The backing has come off. Do you have the envelope you will put the stamp on?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この封筒です。宛名は書き終わっています。右上に空けた所へ、切手をまっすぐ貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 準備済封筒の右上へ直線に貼ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the envelope. I've finished writing the address. I'll attach the stamp straight in the space I left at the upper right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will attach it straight at the upper right of the prepared envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 貼れましたら、浮いている所がないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you've attached it, please check that no parts are lifting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 全部付いています。切手をこすってずらすのでなく、端を指で軽く押さえました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貼付と端の状態を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's completely attached. Instead of rubbing and shifting the stamp, I gently pressed its edges with my finger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that it is attached and check the condition of the edges. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この封筒を、こちらで差し出されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to post this envelope here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。一枚貼った封筒だけお渡しします。外した裏紙は自分の小袋へ入れ、持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒のみ差出し裏紙を持帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll hand over just the envelope with one stamp attached. I'll put the backing paper I removed in my own little bag and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand in only the envelope and take the backing paper home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、封筒をお預かりします。ご準備ありがとうございました。お便りが届きますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take your envelope, then. Thank you for preparing it. I hope your letter reaches its destination. Goodbye.
